items.q: Oh, yeah. He played the clarinet. He died too. He was a very good clarinet.

ctx.x: Everything. Man Perez. Man Perez. He and Man Perez had nothing trouble playing around there. He could play the High Society and make the clarinet. You remember Sidney Bean?
